shortDescription.description: 1–2 sentence description of what the app does and why it's interesting.

thumbnail.description: Relative path to thumbnail; currently always 'thumbnail.svg'.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp when the app was created, e.g. 2026-03-05T02:30:00Z.

visible.description: Whether this app appears in the public app listing. Defaults to true. Set to false to hide without deleting.

allowImprovements.description: Whether community improvement submissions are accepted for this app. Defaults to true. Set to false to prevent new improvements.

homepagePath.description: Entry file for the app; currently always 'index.html'.

inputMode.description: Dominant input style: desktop (keyboard/mouse), mobile (touch/gestures), or responsive for both.

suggestion.description: GitHub Issue that originated this app, if generated from a user suggestion.

issueUrl.description: Full URL to the GitHub Issue.

prompt.description: The original suggestion text submitted by the user.

requestor.description: GitHub username or display name of the person who submitted the suggestion.

improvements.description: Records of improvement pipeline runs applied to this app. Appended by the improvement pipeline — do not set during initial creation.

issueNumber.description: GitHub Issue number for this improvement.

issueUrl.description: Full URL to the GitHub Issue.

description.description: One-sentence summary of what was changed.

requestor.description: GitHub username or display name of the person who requested the improvement.

implementedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the improvement was applied.

agentName.description: Name of the agent that applied the improvement.

llmModel.description: Model identifier used for the improvement.

agentName.description: Name of the primary agent responsible for generation, e.g. 'openclaw-dev-agent'.

totalTokensIn.description: Total input tokens used for this app generation.

totalTokensOut.description: Total output tokens used for this app generation.

runId.description: Transaction runId, must match logs for this app.

notes.description: Brief notes about the generation process or inspiration, including any token estimation caveats.
